critique: The render reads cleanly as an FPGA NTT accelerator — open butterfly frame with all 8 copper multipliers and add/sub pairs exposed, glass BRAM banks down the left edge, exploded radix-4 BU and 10-fin heatsink lifted on posts well clear of the die, nothing floating off the ground line. The defects are not geometric but in fidelity: the scene literally cites the buggy additive bank map b(i)=(i+(i>>3))%8 in bram_0/bram_1/addr_gen while the crossbar notes prove it collides at stride-512 and commits an XOR-fold instead; the exploded radix-4 BU showed THREE twiddle multipliers (the naive datapath) although the authoritative spec commits the optimized 2-mult count; the twiddle-ROM gave two contradictory address functions (block<<stage overflows a 1024-deep ROM); and the FSM listed three overlapping, contradictory state sets. These contradictions are exactly the reproducibility gaps — an engineer could not rebuild from the scene as-was.
changelog: Purged the collision-prone additive bank map b(i)=(i+(i>>3))%8 from bram_0, bram_1, addr_gen_unit role/spec and the crossbar params; committed the XOR-fold bank(i)=(i^(i>>3)^(i>>6)^(i>>9))&7 with offset i>>3 everywhere, and rewrote the crossbar per-stage permutation to the committed cyclic sigma_s rotation

Made the source's headline radix-4 optimization physically present: rebuilt the exploded BU from 3 twiddle multipliers to 2 (W1, W2) and annotated the third product d'=W3*x3 = W1*(W2*x3) as chained through both — exactly the fused pair's two lane DSPs, so '2 mults not 3 / 33% fewer' is now visible; removed ex_mult_w3, updated all four fusion-yoke specs, config_radix_selector and the assembly instructions to match
Reconciled the twiddle-ROM address function to f(stage,block)=(1<<stage)+block (the range-valid form spanning [1,1024)), eliminating the block<<stage variant that overflowed the 1024-deep ROM
Consolidated schedule_controller.fsm from three contradictory state lists into one coherent ordered table and wired DONE as a distinct terminal state: DRAIN->DONE->IDLE on host ack
remaining_gaps: The committed XOR-fold bank/offset and cyclic sigma_s are reproduction reconstructions that satisfy the named conflict-free property but are NOT the paper's actual (untranscribed Sec. III) functions — re-pin if the source mapping is recovered

The 2-multiplier radix-4 datapath (W3=W1*W2 chaining) reproduces the source's 33% claim by a plausible construction, not the paper's exact scheduled butterfly — verify against the source's datapath figure
Twiddle-ROM f(stage,block) and the rearranged twiddle-reuse loop are the committed CT-DIT convention, not the paper's specific rearranged-loop addressing

The central butterfly array is dense in the TOP view; a future pass could fan the 8 lanes apart or thin the add/sub boxes so each lane's mult->add/sub->reg chain is individually traceable from plan view
